summary: Creates or updates a budget note for a budget or a forecasting row
description: Creates or updates a budget note for a budget or a forecasting row

note.description: The note that was saved for a budget or a forecast row

user.description: Display name of the user who last created or updated the note. Null when no author history is available.

updated_at.description: Human-readable, locale- and timezone-formatted timestamp of when the note was last updated. Display only; not ISO 8601.

note.description: Note text for the budget or forecasting row. The note key must be present. Send an empty string or null to clear the note. Omitting the key returns 400.

label.description: The custom name you have assigned to your Budget Note column. Use 'Notes' if using the default name
